response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio AS avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_overall_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY p.rating
